theme_strategy.vibe: Approachable yet premium, warm, grounded, and tactile. Evokes the feeling of physical wine labels, cork, and deep wine hues.
theme_strategy.white_label_customization: System must be structured to easily swap primary colors, logo, and banner images to adapt to different stores while maintaining the core structural layout.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-serif font-bold tracking-tight text-primary-900 leading-tight
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-serif font-semibold tracking-tight text-primary-900
hierarchy.small_label: text-xs font-sans uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-stone-500 font-semibold

spacing_and_layout.storefront_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6

product_card.layout: Vertical stack, pure white background, subtle stone border, no heavy shadow unless hovered.
product_card.image_container: Aspect ratio 4/5 or square. Image centered with subtle background tint (e.g., bg-stone-50) to make the bottle stand out.
product_card.content: p-4. Title left-aligned. Category overline above title. Price block bottom left. Add-to-cart button (icon only or small text) bottom right.
product_card.promo_state: If on promotion: highlight old price crossed out, new price in primary brand color. Add 'Promo' badge absolute top-left.
product_card.hover_state: -translate-y-1 transition-transform duration-300, floating shadow, image slight scale up.

header_nav.desktop: Sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-stone-200. Left: Logo. Center: Search bar. Right: Cart icon + Login/Profile.
header_nav.mobile: Sticky top-0. Hamburger menu, central logo, right cart icon.

search_bar.style: bg-stone-100 border-transparent focus:border-[#722F37] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#722F37]/20 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 w-full transition-all

cart_drawer.items: List of small horizontal bento-style cards. Image left, details center, qty toggle right.
cart_drawer.footer: Total price + 'Finalizar Pedido' primary CTA button sticking to bottom. WhatsApp icon next to 'Finalizar' to indicate the action.

admin_sidebar.layout: Fixed left sidebar on desktop. Dark charcoal (bg-stone-900) or very dark red (bg-[#2A1114]) for clear contrast against the light dashboard content.
admin_sidebar.links: Subtle hover states. Active state gets a left border highlight and lighter background.

admin_data_table.style: Clean white cards. Border collapse, horizontal dividers (border-stone-100). Status badges with soft backgrounds (e.g., bg-green-100 text-green-800 for 'Entregue').

buttons.primary: bg-[#722F37] text-white hover:bg-[#5A252C] transition-colors rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-medium flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: bg-stone-100 text-stone-800 hover:bg-stone-200 transition-colors rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-medium
buttons.outline: border-2 border-[#722F37] text-[#722F37] hover:bg-[#722F37] hover:text-white transition-colors rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-medium

animations.drawer: slide-in from right. Framer motion recommended if available, else CSS transform translate-x.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5, clean, un-filled unless representing an active state (like a filled heart).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary text on main background meets 4.5:1. Primary button text (white on #722F37) meets contrast.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="add-to-cart-btn"`)

hero_banner.description: Wine bottles on a rustic rack. Use as the main storefront banner background with a dark overlay (bg-black/40) to make the white store name text pop.

product_placeholder_1.description: Premium wine bottle on dark background. Use for main product images in the catalog.

product_placeholder_2.description: Bottle of wine on a table. Alternate product image.

category_delivery.description: Delivery bag visual. Can be used in the checkout success modal or 'about delivery' section.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Tailwind config with the custom colors defined in color_palette. Extend the font family with 'sans': ['Outfit', 'sans-serif'] and 'serif': ['Cormorant Garamond', 'serif'].
2. Storefront MUST follow a mobile-first e-commerce pattern (e.g. iFood/Rappi): clear product cards with an "Add" button directly on the card to minimize clicks.
3. Implement the Promo state precisely: cross out the old price in a subtle gray/red line and highlight the new price in the bold primary color (#722F37). Add a 'Promo' tag.

4. For checkout, since it requires a WhatsApp message, structure the flow to collect: Name, Phone, Address, Payment Method, and Observations. Generate the encoded wa.me/ URL dynamically based on cart contents and these details.
5. The Admin dashboard should be structurally separated. Use a clean dense layout (Archetype 4 style grid) for orders and product management to maximize data visibility.
6. USE SHADCN components for complex interactions: Dialogs, Selects, and Toasts (Sonner).
7. CRITICAL: Add `data-testid` to all buttons, inputs, and major containers to allow testing.
8. DO NOT use placeholder text or mock URLs for images. Use the Unsplash URLs provided in `image_urls` for seeding the database or initial static render.
